name: Corporate Presentation
description: Speaking in business contexts like executive meetings, client presentations, or company updates

pace.note: Slightly faster than average to convey confidence and respect time constraints

filler_words.note: Minimize fillers to project confidence and clarity

language.structure: concise with clear bottom line up front
language.note: Use business terminology appropriately; frame messages in terms of value and outcomes

delivery.vocal_variety: moderate to high, used for emphasis
delivery.note: Strong opening and closing; maintain eye contact and poised body language

common_pitfalls: Too much detail without highlighting key insights
Lack of clear recommendations or action items
Not connecting content to business value or strategy
Speaking too long or going off-topic
Failing to address stakeholder concerns or perspectives
recommended_practices: Start with a concise executive summary
Use the 'what, so what, now what' framework
End with clear next steps and ownership

transitions: This directly impacts our bottom line by...
Looking at this from the market perspective...
stakeholder_management: To address your concern about X...
Let me address the ROI question specifically...

tips: Prepare a concise core message and supporting points
Practice with a timer to respect time constraints
Anticipate basic questions about your content
Prepare for challenging questions and objections
Work on vocal variety and authoritative delivery
Frame all communications in terms of strategic impact
Master the art of communicating upward, downward and laterally
Develop the ability to pivot and adapt in real-time
